def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    transaction_amount = 12_000_000
    tier_limits = [1_000_000, 5_000_000, 10_000_000]
    tier_rates = [0.05, 0.04, 0.03, 0.02]

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    first_tier = min(transaction_amount, tier_limits[0])
    second_tier = min(max(transaction_amount - tier_limits[0], 0), 4_000_000)
    third_tier = min(max(transaction_amount - tier_limits[1], 0), 5_000_000)
    fourth_tier = max(transaction_amount - tier_limits[2], 0)

    total_fee = (
        first_tier * tier_rates[0]
        + second_tier * tier_rates[1]
        + third_tier * tier_rates[2]
        + fourth_tier * tier_rates[3]
    )

    # Return the answer rounded to the nearest dollar
    return round(total_fee)
